# Vexplore

A file explorer that suggests instead of asking.

## Install (Windows)

Open **PowerShell** (a normal window - administrator rights are not needed) and run:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sibarum/vexelray-dist/main/apps/vexplore/install.ps1 | iex
```

That is the whole install. It downloads Vexplore 0.1.0, checks every file against the
SHA-256 in the [install manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sibarum/vexelray-dist/main/apps/vexplore/manifest.json), and installs for your user only.

What it does:

- creates the install folder and places the binaries there
- unblocks them and makes sure they are executable
- creates desktop / Start menu shortcuts
- adds the install folder to your user PATH
- writes an install manifest listing everything it installed and where
- adds an uninstaller and an updater next to the binaries, and an entry in Settings > Apps

### Options

Set these in the same PowerShell window *before* the install command:

| Variable | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `$env:INSTALL_VERSION = '1.2.3'` | install a specific version from the [history](#versions) |
| `$env:INSTALL_DIR = 'D:\Apps\Vexplore'` | install somewhere other than `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Vexplore` |
| `$env:INSTALL_NO_SHORTCUTS = '1'` | skip the desktop / Start menu shortcuts |
| `$env:INSTALL_NO_PATH = '1'` | do not add anything to your user PATH |
| `$env:INSTALL_NO_ASSOCIATIONS = '1'` | do not register Vexplore to open any file types |
| `$env:INSTALL_FORCE = '1'` | reinstall even if this version is already installed |

### What gets installed

| File | Kind | Version | Size | Installed to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vexplore.exe` | native executable | 0.1.0 | 43.6 MB | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Vexplore\vexplore.exe` |

Everything installed is recorded in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Vexplore\install-manifest.json`, and a copy
in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\vexelray-installer\installs\vexplore.json`.

### Other programs finding Vexplore

Installs are independent, so Vexplore can sit next to other programs from the same
installer. To start it from one of them without depending on PATH, read
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\vexelray-installer\installs\vexplore.json` and use `commands.<name>.path` - an absolute path to the
executable (the `.cmd` launcher for a jar). Missing file means not installed. Pass arguments
as usual; from Java use `new ProcessBuilder(path, args...)`, and for a `.cmd` launcher run it
as `cmd.exe /c path args...`.

### Update

```powershell
& "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Vexplore\update.cmd"
```

Checks GitHub for newer versions of the binaries and installs them after asking. Use
`-Check` to only look, `-Yes` to skip the question.

### Uninstall

Use **Settings > Apps > Vexplore > Uninstall**, or:

```powershell
& "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Vexplore\uninstall.cmd"
```

The uninstaller reads the install manifests in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\vexelray-installer\installs`, so it removes exactly
what was installed - files, shortcuts, PATH entries, file types and the Apps entry. Files you added to
the install folder are left alone. `uninstall.cmd -List` shows every install it knows about
and `-All` removes them all.

### Is it safe to run a script from the internet?

Read it first - it is one file: [`install.ps1`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sibarum/vexelray-dist/main/apps/vexplore/install.ps1). Downloads are only
accepted when their SHA-256 matches the manifest, and the manifest and script live in this
repository.

macOS and Linux installers are planned; the manifest is already organised per platform.

## Versions

Current version: **0.1.0**. The full history of published versions, with the files,
sizes and checksums of each, is in [`manifest.json`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sibarum/vexelray-dist/main/apps/vexplore/manifest.json).
